question: Which of the following states won the maximum number of medals at the Khelo India Youth Games 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Maharashtra topped the Khelo India Youth Games of the year 2020 with a total of 256 medals.
 
• **Haryana and Delhi **were in the **2nd and 3rd positions.**
 
• Avinash Joshi, CEO of the "Khelo India Games 2020" event has announced that lawn bowls and cycling will be included in the Khelo India for the first time.
 
• The "Khelo India Games 2020" event is the 3rd edition of the games that have taken place between the dates of 10th January 2020 to 22nd January 2020 in Guwahati, Assam.
 
• Under the Khelo India Event for the year 2020, the youth participated across 20 disciplines of sports.
 
• 6500 athletes from 37 teams from all over the country have presented their talent in front of the nation.
 
• The motive of giving financial aid is to provide a chance to athletes of India for an Olympic event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• About Khelo India Youth Games

 
 
• Khelo India Youth Games previously known as Khelo India School Games are national-level multidisciplinary games that are organized for two categories viz. under-17 school students and under-21 college students.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

 
• The Khelo India Youth Games 2021 concluded on 13 June 2022 at Panchkula in Haryana.
 
• The closing ceremony was organised at Indradanush Auditorium in Panchkula.
 
• This was the fourth edition of the Khelo India Youth Games.
 
• Haryana emerged as champion by getting the top position in the medal tally with a total of 137 medals while Maharashtra got the second position by winning 125 medals.
 
• At 13, Jharkhand’s Eitu Mandal is the youngest kabaddi entrant in the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2021.
 
• JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) became the winner of the Khelo India University Games 2021 on 3 May 2022.
